major_concerns: Deterministic verifier may be incomplete (false negatives) — undermines primary outcome validity.
Repair loop may overfit to verifier oracle, producing configs that pass checks but are operationally undesirable.
Prompt/seed sensitivity not fully characterized (single-model, single-prompt risks).
Public task bank representativeness (topology/device diversity) is uncertain.
required_design_repairs: Specify exact verifier tool(s), version, and formal invariants checked (reachability, ACL semantics) and provide canonical oracle cases for verifier validation.
Preregister exact LLM model identifier, prompts, seeds, and schema constraints; publish prompts verbatim.
Define repair-prompt templates, bounded edit operations, and deterministic stopping rules (including handling of verifier timeouts).
Increase human-inspection sampling plan (clear labeling protocol, inter-rater reliability) and/or include golden-reference tasks to estimate verifier/human error rates.
Document dataset generation procedure and ensure public release of topology/policy corpora and scripts.

major_concerns: Translation from configs/topology to SMT is labor-intensive and error-prone; incomplete encoding can produce misleading solver results.
SMT undecidability/timeouts likely at chosen scale; high CPU/time cost may bias task selection toward easy cases.
Lack of a bounded-semantics specification (what is encoded, what is abstracted) threatens interpretability of 'proved' results.
Reproducibility hinges on releasing the translator and precise encodings; without that, results are not verifiable.
required_design_repairs: Specify bounded semantic model (exact abstractions, finite-domain bounds) and provide formal translation specification.
Choose and state SMT solver (e.g., Z3) with version, deterministic settings, and solver-timeout policy; include solver resource plan.
Provide unit tests and a public translator implementation with canonical examples and round-trip checks (config→SMT→counterexample→replayed scenario).
Include fallback or escalation policy for solver timeouts (e.g., fallback to heuristic validator) and prespecify how timed-out cases are analyzed.
Re-evaluate sample size or task complexity to match solver throughput and avoid selection bias; preregister power calculation and timeout sensitivity analyses.

major_concerns: Public vendor syntax corpora may be incomplete or inconsistently licensed — threatens reproducibility and external validity.
'Few-shot adapter' needs precise operationalization (prompt format, selection criteria for examples) to avoid irreproducible ad-hoc choices.
Verifier attribution of failures to syntax versus higher-level semantic mismatch must be defined to avoid misinterpretation.
Holding out a vendor requires careful sampling to avoid confounding vendor complexity with task difficulty.
required_design_repairs: List exact vendor corpora sources and versions, licensing, and preprocessing steps; publish corpora or stable subsets used.
Provide precise adapter construction (example selection method, prompt templates) and preregister the few-shot sets for each vendor.
Specify verifier implementation and diagnostic measures to disambiguate syntax vs semantic failures.
Define vendor hold-out and stratified sampling procedures and preregister analyses for interaction effects between vendor and topology complexity.

major_concerns: Ethical risk from publishing actionable adversarial prompts — needs responsible-disclosure policy.
Red-team bank generation methodology must avoid overfitting defenses to the bank (optimistic mitigation estimates).
Adversarial prompts may include unrealistic operator intents reducing external validity.
Reproducibility requires exact prompt texts, but publication may be restricted for safety.
required_design_repairs: Add an explicit ethical review and redaction/responsible-disclosure plan for adversarial prompts (publish taxonomy/metrics, redact exploitative details).
Preregister red-team generation procedure, validation rules, and ensure randomization in prompt-task pairing to avoid selection bias.
Specify mitigation overfitting controls (e.g., separate tuning vs evaluation red-team splits) and report defense tuning records.
Define criteria for deciding which adversarial prompts are too sensitive to release and provide a safe-summary alternative for sharing research artifacts.

major_concerns: Proposed design requires recruiting/compensating N=30 network engineers — conflicts with declared capability manifest (human_scientific_labour_allowed: false).
Human-subjects work introduces ethics/consent review, protected-data risk, and logistical overhead that are not supported in the manifest.
Simulated or synthetic surrogate operators would materially change the scientific question and interpretation.
Reproducibility is low if human pool, expertise, and UI are not tightly specified and provided.
required_design_repairs: This candidate is infeasible under the supplied capability manifest; either (A) remove human-subject requirement and replace with validated existing datasets of operator decisions (if available) and preregister that substitution, or (B) defer until human-participant procedures, IRB/ethics, and staffing are provisioned outside the current manifest.

If proceeding with humans, preregister recruitment, consent, compensation, annotator selection criteria, UI screenshots, and IRB/ethics approvals; otherwise provide a validated simulation protocol and defend construct validity.
